originalThreshold.argument: Positive inversion reverses h<2^-4096. Squaring positive quantities preserves strict inequality. The original maximum and ceiling are at least their frequency operand.

exactLeadingBackgroundOnFiniteBands.canonicalFirstScale: log(c1)>=requiredLog_1,0=(log2+log B_1,0)/h; B_1,0=max(1, actual norm terms)>=1
exactLeadingBackgroundOnFiniteBands.sequenceRule: The unchanged canonical recipe has c_n>=2*c_(n-1) for every n>=2, hence c_n>=c1.
exactLeadingBackgroundOnFiniteBands.strictInactiveArgument: For every finite displayed band and every n>=1, c_n*q>2^129*2^-129=1.
exactLeadingBackgroundOnFiniteBands.cutoffDefinition: The original complete time cutoff is 1 for t<=1/2, exp(-1/(1-u))/(exp(-1/u)+exp(-1/(1-u))) for 1/2<t<1 with u=2t-1, and 0 for t>=1. Its flat extension and every derivative equal zero for argument>=1. This literal function body and the extra stream derivative are matched to the actual field roots.
exactLeadingBackgroundOnFiniteBands.conclusion: All positive-order normalized background terms, including every differentiated cutoff and the extra stream term, vanish identically on an open neighborhood of each point of these bands. The actual completed F and G equal their original leading fields there.
exactLeadingBackgroundOnFiniteBands.sourceSequenceScope: The currently implemented canonical normalized sequence, and any later enlargement that retains its doubling recurrence. The complete physical and weighted-stress selector is not asserted here.

ellOneGeometry.argument: 0<(1+h)log2/log(4+sqrt2)<1, since 0<h<1 and 2^(1+h)<4<4+sqrt2. Its floor is 0. Substitute original r0=2^-34 and Ls=2*r0/ci. No approximation h=0 is taken.

witness.representative: The same point is fixed as the box representative before any differentiation.
witness.grid: For any fixed mesh origin there is a nearest integer box with all offsets in [-1/2,1/2]. The actual bump is positive there. Equation (6.8) allows any fixed point in a box intersection, not only its center.
witness.domain: The radial-shell and local frozen representative geometry hold. The selected certified domain excludes ell=1. Independently, this witness has q=1/2, so the original conditions q<qbig<=2^(-ell0) exclude it for every ell0>=1. No unspecified ell0 or qbig value is treated as an executed input.

exactLeadingReduction.argument: The authenticated band certificate proves c_n*q>1 for every positive-order canonical cutoff on all finite bands 1..128. All cutoff derivatives, including the extra stream term, vanish on a neighborhood. Completed F,G equal leading F,G exactly, with h kept positive.
exactLeadingReduction.terminal: Xtail=Xb*exp(-3), hence y=log(X/Xtail)=11/4. The terminal heat cutoff is already 1 for y>=1/2. U,M,V and their derivatives vanish after Xv<Xtail. B8/C12/I1/I2 supports precede Xtail. The retained terminal E density gives E=Etail*exp(-A*y)*f_o(y)*H(2/X)/(1-rho).
exactLeadingReduction.chart: At Z=0,T=1 the original strictly monotone chart equation has its exact root s=1. Evenness in Z of s and of the terminal heat argument gives F_Z=0; G=G_R=G_Z=0.

heatAndAlpha.definition: H(z)=Gamma(1+h)^(-1) integral_0^infinity exp(-v)*v^h*(1+z*v)^(-h) dv; z=2/X, rho=h/256. This is exactly 1 minus the retained source heatLoss; no heat argument is set to zero.
heatAndAlpha.gamma: The positive gamma density integrates to one and has first moment 1+h, by integration by parts. Compactification v=t/(1-t) keeps the complete improper tail. All displayed first derivatives are dominated by exp(-v)*v^h times a fixed polynomial.
heatAndAlpha.terminalStep: At delta=1/4, f_o=1-rho*sigma(delta/2), sigma argument=1/8. The logistic exponent is -3072/49<-62 and its derivative is 1024+1024/343<2^11. Since e>2, 0<sigma_prime(1/8)<2^-51. Therefore 0<f_o_prime/f_o<h*2^-59<h/4.
heatAndAlpha.conclusion: alpha=-1-X*F_X/F=h+z*H_prime/H-f_o_prime/f_o lies strictly between h/2 and h. In particular 0<alpha<1/16, F>0, R*F_R=-2*(1+alpha)*F, and lambda0=2*F*sqrt(alpha)>0.

amplitudeAndSize.sourceScalars: T>128, lambda=exp(-1000T), h=exp(-8002T), Pstar=exp(2T), C=exp(logCSelected), XR=110*(C*Pstar)^10, Eenv=exp(C^25600000).
amplitudeAndSize.wait: The literal A.13 integrals have 0<Qsteep<=4, 1<Qb<=7+32008T and rho<=Qp<1. Thus wait=log(Qb/Qp)/(1-h)>0 and wait<=16006T+34 for T>=128. The explicit integral inequalities and source-root bindings are detailed in the accompanying proof document.
amplitudeAndSize.endpoint: Sum all literal stage lengths: y_end=13*exp(1000T)+122009T+135+wait. Therefore y_end+log110+20T<15*exp(1000T). The exact scalar Qsource=2^260*2000^2*Pstar^2*h^-8 exceeds exp(64020T), so logCSelected>=Qsource^200>exp(12804000T)>15*exp(1000T). Hence Xb=110*C^10*Pstar^10*exp(y_end)<C^11 and R<sqrt(2)*C^(11/2)<=C^6.
amplitudeAndSize.amplitude: The terminal-start amplitude Etail<=Pstar: the initial endpoint log increment is -1/5 and all subsequent preterminal endpoint increments are negative (wait>0); angular bumps vanish at their endpoints. At y=11/4, 0<f_o<=1, 1-rho>1/2 and H<=1 give F<=2*Pstar/sqrt(2XR)=2/(sqrt220*C^5*Pstar^4)<1.
amplitudeAndSize.noScalarRounding: These are inequalities between original exact positive expressions, not evaluations of their enormous numerical values.

carriers.geometry: The band certificate gives k=2, 1/2<epsilon<1, Ls=2^(-32+h)<2^-31. N=(-1,0), K=(0,-1), c0=-sqrt(alpha), u=2*Eenv^10.
carriers.rounding: The literal pTilde has the chosen sign. floor(k*pTilde+1/2), with the source sign-preserving nonzero fallback, gives sign(p)=sign and |p|>=1/2. No symmetric tie rule or equality p=+/-1/2 is assumed. p and pz remain frozen with respect to slow coordinates and pulse time.
carriers.normal: Set b=p/R, c=-Bs. Then nr=sign*Bs*u/2+2*(1+alpha)*F*b*v, ntheta=b, nz=c. On 0<=v<=Ls, nr/b>0, |nr/b|<1/512<1/32 and |c/b|<2^-40<1/128. The drift is at most (17/8)*2^-31<1/1024.

pulseSign.equation: The actual moving-frame identities give t_prime=(Aphi-d*I)t, d=epsilon*k^2*|n|^2>=0; P_prime/P=lambda-dref and the retained w matrix cancel those reference scalars. With a(v)=exp(integral_0^v d)*t(v)/P(0), a_prime=Aphi*a and a(0)=B(0)e1.
pulseSign.closedSystem: The first two components close because the third Aphi column is zero. With Dn=nr^2+b^2+c^2, M11=-2F(1+2alpha)nr*b/Dn, M12=2F(b^2+c^2)/Dn, M21=2F[alpha(nr^2+c^2)-(1+alpha)b^2]/Dn, M22=-2F*nr*b/Dn. The actual constructor and these identities are checked by exact rational arithmetic.
pulseSign.initial: a_r(0)=1. The negative theta term has magnitude Bs*u*|b|/[2*(b^2+Bs^2)] and the positive term is sqrt(alpha)*sqrt(1+u^2/4)*Bs/sqrt(b^2+Bs^2). Their ratio squared is alpha*(1+4/u^2)*(1+(Bs/b)^2)<=16385/131072<1. Thus a_theta(0)<0 and |a_theta(0)|<=|nr(0)/b|<1.
pulseSign.interval: M21<0 and ||M||infinity<4F. The initial two-vector norm is 1, so |a_r(v)-1|<=exp(4F*Ls)-1<1/(2^29-1)<1/2; here exp(x)<=1/(1-x) for 0<=x<1. Hence a_r>1/2. The scalar integrating-factor formula a_theta(v)=exp(integral M22)*(a_theta(0)+integral exp(-integral M22)*M21*a_r) is strictly negative. Restoring P(0)>0 and positive damping preserves both signs.

targetAndCovariance.target: The exact full leading target includes the original I,J,S,Cp and both viscous shear terms, with every B8/C12/I1/I2/heat correction and the matching moment identities. On terminal y>=1/2 it is the stress of Appendix A.54. Every A.54 term is nonnegative because the full heat K>0, K_r<0 and f_o_prime>=0. At y=11/4 the boundary K*f_r is strictly positive, hence Ttheta>0. The source slow target factor s^(-A-1/2)=1 at this witness.
targetAndCovariance.covariance: Both source Htheta columns equal the positive Haar factor times integral_0^Ls psi(v)^2*t_r(v)*t_theta(v) dv. The actual psi is identically one on [Ls/4,3Ls/4]. Thus Htheta_plus<0 and Htheta_minus<0.
targetAndCovariance.conclusion: For every pair y_plus,y_minus>=0, the theta row of H*y is <=0, whereas Ttheta>0. Therefore H*y=T has no nonnegative solution at this actual literal ell=1 witness. If det(H) is nonzero, at least one inverse weight is negative; neither determinant nonvanishing nor individual inverse signs follow.
